title: Function wrapped around a column in WHERE
claim: Wrapping a column in a function makes indexes useless: rewrite as a range, or index the computed value.
verdict: Confirmed. date_c::date = day forced a parallel scan of all 5M rows ({t:cast_date}); the equivalent range used
the date index ({t:range}, {x:cast_date/range} faster). lower(developeremail) scanned all 15M archive rows
({t:lower_email}); an expression index brought it to {t:lower_email_indexed}, about the speed of the plain
column ({t:plain_email}; the rest is fetching 160k matching rows). PostgreSQL offers both fixes: rewrite as a
